questions.q: This structured process coordinates the handling of a security incident, including analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.

In the NIST incident response lifecycle, this phase focuses on restoring affected systems, verifying normal operation, and monitoring for signs of renewed compromise after containment and eradication.
